notes: DisplayPort does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The interoperability-relevant facts are the DPCD capability registers (DPCD_REV, MAX_LINK_RATE, MAX_LANE_COUNT, FEC/DSC caps) read over AUX and the Sink's EDID read by I2C-over-AUX; an implementation may back these with ROM/fuses, but the spec only requires they be discoverable. HDCP devices also hold factory keys.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: DPCD revision advertised by the Sink.
Maximum Main Link rate the Sink supports (RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3).

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.location: Sink I2C ROM (I2C address A0h, via I2C-over-AUX)
otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Display capability/timing descriptor; factory-programmed in the Sink.
